# DeepSeek Harness for VS Code > 在 VS Code 提供基于内置 Harness 运行时的原生工作台与会话入口。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[skymecode/deepseek-harness-for-vscode](https://github.com/skymecode/deepseek-harness-for-vscode) - **版本号**：0.6.1（[固定提交 9a82e266cb8c857e906e629bd36e5531a3909cf1](https://github.com/skymecode/deepseek-harness-for-vscode/tree/9a82e266cb8c857e906e629bd36e5531a3909cf1)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-23（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态核查固定提交的VS Code 激活、回环宿主和版本迁移。未执行目标代码或实际宿主验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要在 VS Code 里使用 Harness 的开发者可以评估原生工作台。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 把运行时与编辑器服务组合。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 源码和 VSIX 运行时版本有差异，数据升级要留备份。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 验证恢复时的版本提示。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 先验证对应平台包并保留旧历史。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 把运行时与编辑器服务组合。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 源码和 VSIX 运行时版本有差异，数据升级要留备份。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 验证恢复时的版本提示。 用合成 V4 历史做隔离实验 ## 场景与替代办法 需要在 VS Code 里使用 Harness 的开发者可以评估原生工作台。 独立 Web 页面可用，但要切换窗口。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 平台 VSIX | 必需 | 安装扩展 | 回独立 DSH | | 运行时与配置 | 必需 | 连接模型和会话 | 无法完整使用 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 核对平台包 | 备份历史 | | 核查 | 打开测试工作区 | 检查运行时和会话 | | 退出 | 停用扩展 | 保留历史 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 资源费用未知 | 准备耗时未知 | 版本差异 | | 持续 | 推理费用未知 | 维护耗时未知 | 依赖宿主 | | 恢复 | 恢复资源未知 | 备份验证耗时未知 | 历史未测 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 编辑器内入口 | 激活和网关接线明确 | 真实安装效果 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：VS Code 激活、回环宿主和版本迁移 ### Q01 · 编辑器中的增量是什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 扩展注册原生侧栏与命令，并构造编辑器选择、文件和网关服务。相对切去 DSH Web，用户可在 IDE 内进入会话；其宿主能力仍由打包 Harness 提供。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:5-13](https://github.com/skymecode/deepseek-harness-for-vscode/blob/9a82e266cb8c857e906e629bd36e5531a3909cf1/README.md#L5-L13) 作者定位与发行差异 ```text A native VS Code coding-agent extension powered by [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Install the platform-specific VSIX and start working—there is no upstream repository to clone, no Node/npm setup, and no local Harness deployment to manage. > This is the community-maintained **0.6.1 codebase with unreleased fixes**. Current source pins the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.3` package (Typert Remote protocol). The published 0.6.1 assets still contain `0.2.1-alpha.1`; DeepSeek Harness remains a Developer Preview. Pending updates fix duplicate user prompts appearing after their answers when editor context is attached, preserve message order during streaming and rapid submissions, and support the new external-task entries in the native subagent catalog. See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md). > **Runtime upgrade:** Harness now uses session format V4. Supported older logs are migrated on resume into a new generation while their original files are preserved. Old runtimes cannot read the new V4 generation; back up the shared history home (default `~/.dsh`) and the private `~/.dsh/vscode/harness-home` before upgrading, and do not downgrade an active profile. Third-party plugins using the removed `ctx.agent` or runtime `Inbox` APIs need their own compatibility updates. The extension keeps its native VS Code interface rather than embedding the official Web UI. Startup uses the official runtime package resolver. Only a recognized legacy module conflict triggers one bounded backup-and-repair attempt; ordinary profile packages are no longer moved on every startup or installation. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/extension.ts:36-51](https://github.com/skymecode/deepseek-harness-for-vscode/blob/9a82e266cb8c857e906e629bd36e5531a3909cf1/src/extension.ts#L36-L51) 工作台服务

#### 缺口 - 未运行编辑器 **影响**：无法判断实际操作效率 **进一步探讨**：对照打开同一项目和会话 ### Q02 · 宿主怎样启动？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 激活时给 NO_PROXY 加入 loopback，使用运行时解析器构造网关。宿主使用回环及随机端口启动，并带 overlay。独立进程能被工作台控制，回环不是多用户隔离。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/extension.ts:24-43](https://github.com/skymecode/deepseek-harness-for-vscode/blob/9a82e266cb8c857e906e629bd36e5531a3909cf1/src/extension.ts#L24-L43) 回环代理和激活

查看原文（25行） ```text // Healthy launches do not create a lock or a backup directory. if ((await conflicts(modules, names)).length === 0) return [] // This is exactly app-boot's .lock, not a parallel // extension-only lock. Never steal a lock based on its age. return await withFileLock(modules, async () => { if (!await ordinaryDirectory(profiles) || !await ordinaryDirectory(modules)) return [] const candidates = await conflicts(modules, names) const moved: ModuleFallbackBackup[] = [] let backupRoot: string | undefined for (const packageName of candidates) { const original = join(modules, packageName) // Recheck ownership/type while holding the official lock: another window // may already have healed the directory since the initial inspection. if (!await conflictEntry(modules, packageName)) continue backupRoot ??= await mkdtemp(join(canonicalHome, 'module-fallback-backup-')) const backup = join(backupRoot, packageName) await mkdir(dirname(backup), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 }) try { await rename(original, backup) } catch (error) { // A failed rename never authorizes deleting the source. 'unknown error'}); existing files were preserved.`, { cause: error }) } const entry = { packageName, original, backup } ```
#### 缺口 - 未核对真实发行包和迁移 **影响**：不能确认原历史可读 **进一步探讨**：备份合成历史并对照旧、新版本 ### Q04 · 怎样安排有限试用？ **研究主题**：依赖、兼容与流程、效果与总成本、采用判断 #### 完整回答 先核对对应平台 VSIX 与内置宿主版本，用独立工作区与合成历史核对会话显示、运行时重载和撤除扩展。已有历史先备份，发生不兼容则保留旧数据环境。安装、模型和迁移耗时未测。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:7-26](https://github.com/skymecode/deepseek-harness-for-vscode/blob/9a82e266cb8c857e906e629bd36e5531a3909cf1/README.md#L7-L26) 发行和历史注意

The published 0.6.1 assets still contain `0.2.1-alpha.1`; DeepSeek Harness remains a Developer Preview. Pending updates fix duplicate user prompts appearing after their answers when editor context is attached, preserve message order during streaming and rapid submissions, and support the new external-task entries in the native subagent catalog. See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md). > **Runtime upgrade:** Harness now uses session format V4. Supported older logs are migrated on resume into a new generation while their original files are preserved. Old runtimes cannot read the new V4 generation; back up the shared history home (default `~/.dsh`) and the private `~/.dsh/vscode/harness-home` before upgrading, and do not downgrade an active profile. Third-party plugins using the removed `ctx.agent` or runtime `Inbox` APIs need their own compatibility updates. The extension keeps its native VS Code interface rather than embedding the official Web UI. Startup uses the official runtime package resolver. Only a recognized legacy module conflict triggers one bounded backup-and-repair attempt; ordinary profile packages are no longer moved on every startup or installation. ## 0.6.1 release update This update connects the DSH 0.2.1 services and trims unused runtime resources: - **Background jobs:** view progress, expand live output, and confirm cancellation from Context → Jobs. Output resumes after reconnects; collapsing cancels observation while live updates retain focus and scroll position. - **Session management:** native pins, workspace ordering, archive/restore, and activity details before “Stop and archive.” Search includes both active and archived conversations. - **Schedules:** reminder cards appear in Context → Schedules when the current Profile enables Schedule; delete tasks and browse delivery history from the workbench, while creation remains a native DSH tool. - **Marketplace recovery:** source failures are visible, successful results stay cached for the current extension session, and reopening retries failed loads. Three built-in recipes are no longer reported as the entire GitHub catalog. - **Display and compatibility fixes:** completed reasoning shows at least `1s`, cross-platform file links are more reliable, and a native declaration keeps legacy `code` sessions usable. - **Smaller packages:** unused LibreOfficeKit, official Web document preview and experimental voice payloads are excluded. The local macOS arm64 VSIX is about **94 MiB (98.58 MB)**, down from about 196 MiB before trimming; other platform sizes vary. Download the VSIX from the [v0.6.1 release](https://github.com/skymecode/deepseek-harness-for-vscode/releases/tag/v0.6.1) and reload VS Code after installation.
